Diagnosis: Rasmussen's encephalitis
Evidence: Progressive nature of symptoms, presence of focal brain injury suggested by cystic encephalomalacia and gliosis
2:
Diagnosis: Hemispheric Sturge-Weber syndrome
Evidence: Marked asymmetry of the cerebral hemispheres, significant atrophy of the right cerebral hemisphere, but lack of port-wine stains and leptomeningeal angiomatosis
